40004814.author: पदार्थः
40004814.content: अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, आक्रन्दितनिरानन्दा rendered cheerless by the lamentations, सास्रकण्ठजनाकुला filled with sobbing people, अवतताः stretched interminably, सा शर्वरी that night, व्यतीयाय passed away.

40004814.author: Translation
40004814.content: The night stretched interminably in Ayodhya, which was filled with sobbing people  rendered cheerless by their lamentations.

40004815.author: पदार्थः
40004815.content: ततः then, शर्वर्याम् when the night, व्यतीतायां तु passed, आदित्यस्य उदये at sunrise, राजकर्तारः those who perform royal investiture, द्विजातयः brahmins, समेत्य having been called, सभाम् assembly hall, ईयुः reached.

40004815.author: Translation
40004815.content: When the night finally ended and after the sunrise next day, the brahmins who perform royal investiture having been called and reached the assembly hall.

40004816.author: पदार्थः
40004816.content: मार्कण्डेयः Markandeya, अथ and, मौद्गल्यः Maudgalya, अथ also, काश्यपः Kasyapa, कात्यायनः Katyayana, गौतमश्च Gautama also, महायशाः of great renown, जाबालिश्च Jabali too, एते  these, द्विजाः brahmins, अमात्यैः सह with ministers, श्रेष्ठम् the chief, राजपुरोहितम् king's priest, वसिष्ठमेव Vasistha himself, अभिमुखाः approached, पृथक् different, वाचम् opinions  उदीरयन् expressed.

40004816.author: Translation
40004816.content: Markandeya, Maudgalya, Kasyapa, Katyayana, Gautama, Jabali of great renown   accompanied by ministers and brahmins approached Vasistha, the chief  priest of the king and expressed different opinions (on the investiture).

40004817.author: पदार्थः
40004817.content: मार्कण्डेयः Markandeya, अथ and, मौद्गल्यः Maudgalya, अथ also, काश्यपः Kasyapa, कात्यायनः Katyayana, गौतमश्च Gautama also, महायशाः of great renown, जाबालिश्च Jabali too, एते  these, द्विजाः brahmins, अमात्यैः सह with ministers, श्रेष्ठम् the chief, राजपुरोहितम् king's priest, वसिष्ठमेव Vasistha himself, अभिमुखाः approached, पृथक् different, वाचम् opinions  उदीरयन् expressed.

40004817.author: Translation
40004817.content: Markandeya, Maudgalya, Kasyapa, Katyayana, Gautama, Jabali of great renown   accompanied by ministers and brahmins approached Vasistha, the chief  priest of the king and expressed different opinions (on the investiture).

40004818.author: पदार्थः
40004818.content: अस्मिन् पार्थिवे this king, पुत्रशोकेन out of grief over (seperation from) his son, पञ्चत्वम् dissolution into the five elements (death), आपन्ने having attained, या that night, नः for us, वर्षशतोपमा like a hundred years, शर्वरी such night, दुःखम्  sorrowful, अतीता passed.

40004818.author: Translation
40004818.content: While king Dasaratha died on account of grief over (separation from) his son and rejoined the five elements, the sorrowful night seemed like a hundred years for us. (commented the assembly of ministers).

40004819.author: पदार्थः
40004819.content: महाराजः the great king, स्वर्गतश्च had attained heaven, रामश्च Rama also, अरण्यम् in the forest, आश्रितः taken refuge, तेजस्वी lustrous, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana, रामेणैव सह with Rama, गतः went.

40004819.author: Translation
40004819.content: The great king has attained heaven, Rama has taken refuge in the forest and brilliant Lakshmana has also gone with Rama.

40004820.author: पदार्थः
40004820.content: परन्तपौ destroyers of enemies, भरतशत्रुघ्नौ Bharata and Satrughna, उभौ both, केकयेषु in the Kekaya kingdom, राजगृहे at Rajagriha, पुरे city, रम्ये beautiful, मातामहनिवेशने are in maternal grandfather's palace.

40004820.author: Translation
40004820.content: Bharata and Satrughna, destroyers of enemies, are at the beautiful city of Rajagriha in the Kekaya kingdom, the palace of their maternal grandfather's palace.

40004821.author: पदार्थः
40004821.content: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् in the race of Ikshvakus, कश्चित् anyone, इह here, अद्यैव right now, राजा as king, विधीयताम् should be made, अराजकम् without a king, नः our, राष्ट्रम् country, विनाशम्  destruction, (सम् अव) आप्नुयात् will attain.

40004821.author: Translation
40004821.content: Therefore, let someone from the race of Ikshvakus be appointed king right now.  since without a king, the country will be destroyed.

40004822.author: पदार्थः
40004822.content: अराजके where there is no king, जनपदे in a country, विद्युन्माली garlanded with a row of lightning, महास्वनः thunderous, पर्जन्यः raingod, महीम् the earth, दिव्येन with celestial, वारिणा with rain, नाभिवर्षति does not shower.

40004822.author: Translation
40004822.content: In a country without a king, thunderous clouds garlanded by lightning would no longer water the earth with celestial showers.

40004823.author: पदार्थः
40004823.content: अराजके where there is no king, जनपदे in a country, बीजमुष्टिः handfuls of seeds, न प्रकीर्यते will not be sown (sprout), अराजके where there no king, पुत्र: son, भार्या वा or wife, पितुः father's, वशे control, न वर्तते do not remain.

40004823.author: Translation
40004823.content: Where there is no king, even a handful of seeds will not be sown (will not sprout). In a kingless kingdom, a son or a wife will not obey the father (head of the family).

40004824.author: पदार्थः
40004824.content: अराजके when there is no king, धनम् wealth, नास्ति not, अराजके without a king, भार्यापि even wife, नास्ति is not, अत्याहितम् cause of great peril, अन्यत् another, इदं च this one also exists, अराजके where there no king, सत्यम् truth, कुतः where?

40004824.author: Translation
40004824.content: In a kingdom without a king wealth cannot be preserved, no wife would like to stay (with her husband). There is one more cause for a great peril, that is, there is no place for truth in a country (where there is no king).

40004825.author: पदार्थः
40004825.content: अराजके where there is no king, जनपदे in a country, नराः people, हृष्टाः rejoiced, सभाम्  assembly, रम्याणि delightful, उद्यानानि gardens, पुण्यगृहाणि sacred edifices (like temples), न कारयन्ति are not built.

40004825.author: Translation
40004825.content: In a country where there is no king, no assemblies are convened by pleasure seeking people, nor do they build delightful gardens or sacred edifices.

40004826.author: पदार्थः
40004826.content: अराजके without a king, जनपदे in a country, यज्ञशीलाः where sacrificial ceremonies are conducted, दान्ताः selfcontrolled, ब्राह्मणाः versed in the study of Vedas, संशितव्रताः of rigorous austerity, द्विजातयः brahmins, सत्राणि sacrifices, न अन्वासते do not practise.

40004826.author: Translation
40004826.content: In a country without a king, selfcontrolled brahmins in charge of sacrificial ceremonies, wellversed in the study of Vedas and strict followers of  austerity will not function.

40004827.author: पदार्थः
40004827.content: अराजके without a king, जनपदे in a country, महायज्ञेषु in great sacrifices, यज्वनः the officiating priests, वसुसम्पन्नाः wealthy, ब्राह्मणाः brahmins, आप्तदक्षिणाः abundant gifts, न विसृजन्ति do not offer.

40004827.author: Translation
40004827.content: In a country without a king wealthy brahmins, who have performed great sacrifices, do not offer abundance of gifts to the officiating priests.

40004828.author: पदार्थः
40004828.content: अराजके where there is no king, जनपदे in a country, प्रभूतनटनर्तकाः actors and dancers in large numbers, राष्ट्रवर्धनाः promoting the welfare of the country, उत्सवाश्च celebrations, समाजाश्च assemblies, न वर्धन्ते do not prosper.

40004828.author: Translation
40004828.content: In a country without a king, celebrations of associations promoting the welfare of the country, actors and dancers in large numbers do not prosper.

40004829.author: पदार्थः
40004829.content: अराजके where there is no king, जनपदे in a country, व्यवहारिणः those engaged in lawsuits, सिद्धार्थाः succeed, न not, कथाशीलाः those who are accustomed to storytelling, कथाप्रियैः with those who love to listen to stories, कथाभिः with stories, न अनुरज्यन्ते are not entertained.

40004829.author: Translation
40004829.content: Where there is no king, those engaged in lawsuits will not succeed and those who are accustomed to storytelling will not entertain those who love to listen to stories.

40004830.author: पदार्थः
40004830.content: अराजके without a king, जनपदे in a country, हेमभूषिताः adorned with golden ornaments, कुमार्यः maidens, समागताः having met together, सायाह्ने in the evening, क्रीडितुम् for sporting, उद्यानानि in the pleasure gardens, नयान्ति will not go.

40004830.author: Translation
40004830.content: In a country without a king, young ladies adorned with golden ornaments no longer meet in the evening at the pleasure garden for sporting.

40004831.author: पदार्थः
40004831.content: अराजके without a king, जनपदे in a country, कामिनः pleasureseeking men, नराः men, नारीभिः with women too, शीघ्रगामिभिः by swift moving, वाहनैः chariots, अरण्यानि in the woods (for recreation), न निर्यान्ति will not go.

40004831.author: Translation
40004831.content: In a country without a king, pleasureseeking men will not drive in the woods on swiftmoving chariots with women.

40004832.author: पदार्थः
40004832.content: अराजके without a king, जनपदे in a country, कृषिगोरक्षजीविनः living by farming and  protecting cattle, धनवन्तः wealthy people, सुरक्षिताः wellprotected, विवृतद्वाराः with the doors wide open, न शेरते do not sleep.

40004832.author: Translation
40004832.content: In a country without a king, wealthy people who live on farming and raising cattle cannot sleep safely in their homes with doors wide open.

40004833.author: पदार्थः
40004833.content: अराजके without a king, जनपदे in a country, षष्टिहायनाः sixty years of age, कुञ्जराः elephants, बद्धघण्टाविषाणिनः of tusks adorned with bells, राजमार्गेषु on the highways, न अटन्ति will not wander about.

40004833.author: Translation
40004833.content: In a country without a king, young elephants of sixty years of age, their tusks adorned with bells no longer wander about on the highways.

40004834.author: पदार्थः
40004834.content: अराजके without a king, जनपदे in a country, इष्वस्त्राणाम् arrows and weapons, उपासने practising (the discharge of), सन्ततम् ceaselessly, शरान् arrows, अस्यताम् shooters  throwing, तलनिर्घोषः clappings of the cord on the skin shield (Tala means a protective covering made of hard skin worn on the left hand to prevent injury), न श्रूयते are not heard.

40004834.author: Translation
40004834.content: In a country without a king, the sounds of the ceaseless discharge of arrows and practice of weapons, the clappings of the cord on the skin shield of shooters throwing the arrows are no longer heard.

40004835.author: पदार्थः
40004835.content: अराजके without a king, जनपदे in a country, दूरगामिनः travelling long distances, वणिजः merchants, बहुपण्यसमाचिताः with several kinds of marketable goods, क्षेमम् safely, अध्वानम् on the way, न गच्छन्ति do not go.

40004835.author: Translation
40004835.content: In a country without a king merchants travelling long distances with several kinds of saleable goods cannot go safely on their way.

40004836.author: पदार्थः
40004836.content: अराजके where there is no king, जनपदे in a country, एकचरः moving alone, वशी selfcontrolled, आत्मना in mind, आत्मानाम् on the higher self, भावयन् contemplating, यत्रसायं गृहः inn, मुनिः ascetic, न चरति does not wander.

40004836.author: Translation
40004836.content: In a country where there is no king, an ascetic who (normally) moves alone, selfcontrolled and contemplating on the higher self no longer wanders or rests in the inn.

40004837.author: पदार्थः
40004837.content: नाराजके without a king, जनपदे in a country, योगक्षेमम् security of possession, न प्रवर्तते does not exist, अराजके without a king, सेना army, युधि in a battle, शत्रून् enemies, न विषहते not be able to oppose.

40004837.author: Translation
40004837.content: In a country without a king, there is no security of possessions and the army cannot withstand the  enemy in a battle.

40004838.author: पदार्थः
40004838.content: अराजके without a king, जनपदे in the country, नराः men, परिमण्डिताः welldressed, हृष्टैः enthusiastically, परमवाजिभिः of excellent horses, रथैश्च chariots, सहसा at once, न संयान्ति will not go.

40004838.author: Translation
40004838.content: In a country without a king, welldressed men are no longer enthusiastic to drive on excellent horses and on chariots.

40004839.author: पदार्थः
40004839.content: अराजके with no king, जनपदे in the country, शास्त्रविशारदाः those wellversed in scriptures, नराः people, वनेषु in the forests, उपवनेषु च in the (recreational) gardens, संवदन्तः conversing, न अवतिष्ठन्ते do not stay.

40004839.author: Translation
40004839.content: In a country with no king people proficient in scriptures do not withdraw to the forests and (recreational) gardens for debates (on scriptures).

40004840.author: पदार्थः
40004840.content: अराजके where there is no king, जनपदे in the country, नियतैः by disciplined ones in spiritual practices, जनैः people, देवताभ्यर्चनार्थाय for worshipping the gods, माल्यमोदकदक्षिणाः garlands of flowers, sweetmeats and alms, न कल्प्यन्ते  do not arrange.

40004840.author: Translation
40004840.content: In a country where there is no king, people who are disciplined in spiritual practices do not offer garlands of flowers, sweetmeats and alms while worshipping gods.

40004841.author: पदार्थः
40004841.content: अराजके where there is no king, जनपदे in the country, राजपुत्रा: princes, चन्दनागरुरूषिताः  anointed with sandal paste and agaru, वसन्ते in spring time, शाखिनः इव like trees, न राजन्ते do not look graceful.

40004841.author: Translation
40004841.content: In a country where there is no king, the princes, anointed with sandal paste and agaru, no longer look graceful like blosoming trees in spring time.

40004842.author: पदार्थः
40004842.content: अनुदकाः without water, नद्यः rivers, यथा as, आतृणम् without vegetation, वनम् forest, यथा वा or as, आगोपालाः without cowherds, गावः cows, यथा as, अराजकम् without a king, राष्ट्रम्  country, तथा is like that.

40004842.author: Translation
40004842.content: (The kingdom without a king) is like rivers without water, forests without vegetation and  cows without cowherds.

40004843.author: पदार्थः
40004843.content: रथस्य of the chariot, ध्वजः the pennant, प्रज्ञानम् a mark of identification, विभावसोः for fire, धूमः smoke, ज्ञानम् is a mark of identification, तेषाम् for such, नः for us, यः that, ध्वजः  pennant  (with his magnanimity we are recognised), सः राजा that king, इतः from here, देवत्वम् to heaven, गतः has gone.

40004843.author: Translation
40004843.content: The pennant is an identification for one's chariot. Smoke is a mark of identifying fire. All of us are recognised by the pennant (magnanimity) of the king and such a king has gone to heaven.

40004844.author: पदार्थः
40004844.content: अराजके where there is no king, जनपदे in the country, कस्य चित् for any one, स्वकम् as his own, न भवति does not exist, नराः men, मत्स्याः इव like fish, नित्यम् ceaselessly, परस्परम्  one another, भक्षयन्ति devour.

40004844.author: Translation
40004844.content: In a country where there is no king, no one can own anything and, like fish, people devour one another ceaselessly.

40004845.author: पदार्थः
40004845.content: सम्भिन्नमर्यादाः those disregarding the bounds of morality, छिन्नसंशयाः dispelling doubts, ये हि those, नास्तिकाः atheists, तेऽपि they also, राजदण्डनिपीडिताः when subjected to royal  punishment, भावाय for virtuous path, कल्पन्ते adopt.

40004845.author: Translation
40004845.content: Atheists, who disregard the bounds of morality and live freely dispelling doubts will tend to follow virtuous path out of fear when subjected to royal punishment.

40004846.author: पदार्थः
40004846.content: दृष्टिः eye, नित्यमेव perpetually, यथा as, शरीरस्य of the body (for its protection), प्रवर्तते is engaged, तथा similarly, नरेन्द्रः king, राष्ट्रस्य for the country's, सत्यधर्मयोः for truth and ethics, प्रभवः is the source.

40004846.author: Translation
40004846.content: The king is the source for protecting the truth and morality of a country like the eye which perpetually watches the welfare of the body.

40004847.author: पदार्थः
40004847.content: राजा king, सत्यं च truth, धर्मश्च righteousness, राजा king, कुलवताम् for men of good families, कुलम् family, राजा king alone, माता mother, पिताचैव father also, राजा king, नृणाम् for people, हितकरः one who renders welfare.

40004847.author: Translation
40004847.content: The king is the protector of truth and righteousness, of men of good families. He is father, and mother. He alone renders welfare of the people.

40004848.author: पदार्थः
40004848.content: ततः for that reason, यमः lord of death, Yama, वैश्रवणः Vaisravana, शक्रः Indra, महाबलः  mighty, वरुणश्च Varuna, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, महता excellent, वृत्तेन with conduct विशेष्यन्ते are surpassed.

40004848.author: Translation
40004848.content: Hence, the king with his excellent conduct surpasses mighty Yama, Vaisravana, Indra and Varuna.

40004849.author: पदार्थः
40004849.content: अहो how great, राजा a king, साध्वसाधुनी good and evil actions, विभजन् showing the distinction, लोके in the world, न भवेद्यदि if it were not to happen, इदम् this, तमः स्यात्  would be darkness, किञ्चन even a little, न प्रज्ञायेत could not have been known.

40004849.author: Translation
40004849.content: If the king did not show the distinction between the good and evil actions, this world would have been enveloped by darkness. Nothing could have been seen. How great (is the king)?

40004850.author: पदार्थः
40004850.content: महाराजे when the great king, जीवत्यपि was alive also, वयम् we, सर्वे all, सागरः sea, वेलाम्  shore, प्राप्येव after reaching, तव your, वचनमेव words, नातिक्रमामहे never overstepped.

40004850.author: Translation
40004850.content: Even while the great king was alive, we never defied your word like the ocean which does not overstep its shore.

40004851.author: पदार्थः
40004851.content: द्विजवर्य O best of brahmins, सः you, वृत्तम् all that has happened, समीक्ष्य having considered, नृपं विना without a king, राज्यम् kingdom, अरण्यभूतम् like a forest, त्वमेव yourself, इह here, वदान्यम् generous, इक्ष्वाकु सुतम् born in the Ikshvaku race, कुमारम् son, नः for us, राजानम् as king, अभिषिञ्च consecrate him.

40004851.author: Translation
40004851.content: O Vasistha, the best of brahmins, considering all that has happened and knowing that a kingdom without a king is like a forest, you may consecrate a generous son from  the Ikshvaku race as our king. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyseventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
